title: Oncoplastic Surgery Outcomes Database
official: Understanding Long-Term Outcomes of Oncoplastic Breast Surgery
summary: This is a retrospective and prospective chart review of surgical outcomes and collecting patient satisfaction outcomes using validated surveys for oncoplastic breast surgery and Goldilocks mastectomy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biological females \>= 18 years old requiring oncologic breast surgery with and without reconstruction at Tufts Medicine.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Biological females \< 18 years old
